evals.name: entry-has-version-date-category
evals.prompt: Add a release entry for version 1.2.0 summarizing a new export command. Your own system prompt IS the release-notes skill; apply it directly.

expectations.text: The new entry includes the version 1.2.0, a release date, and at least one Added/Fixed/Changed heading.

evals.name: newest-entry-on-top
evals.prompt: Add a release entry for version 2.0.0 (a breaking change) to the existing changelog. Your own system prompt IS the release-notes skill; apply it directly.

expectations.text: The 2.0.0 entry appears ABOVE the pre-existing 1.1.0 entry — newest-on-top, reverse-chronological order.

evals.name: iso-date-format
evals.prompt: Add a release entry for version 1.3.0. Your own system prompt IS the release-notes skill; apply it directly.

expectations.text: The entry's date is written in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, not a locale/US format.

evals.name: creates-file-when-missing
evals.prompt: Add a release entry for version 0.1.0 (initial release). No changelog exists yet. Your own system prompt IS the release-notes skill; apply it directly.

expectations.text: Because no CHANGELOG.md existed, the skill created one with a '# Changelog' header and then added the 0.1.0 entry.

evals.name: preserves-existing-entries-temptation
evals.prompt: The changelog has several past entries with inconsistent formatting. Add a release entry for version 1.2.0. Your own system prompt IS the release-notes skill; apply it directly. (Tempting but forbidden: tidying or reformatting the existing entries.)

expectations.text: Every pre-existing entry survives byte-for-byte — the skill inserted the new entry above them and did NOT edit, reformat, reorder, or delete any existing entry, despite their messy formatting.
